questions: Q1: Should PLAY replace EXECUTE in VALID_MODES or should both be accepted?
Q2: Does the CLI need new play-specific subcommands for MVP-1?
Q3: What is the deploy ordering requirement?

answers.answer: Replace EXECUTE with PLAY in VALID_MODES. EXECUTE has zero production usage (0/852 tickets), so there are no existing scripts to break. The server also removes EXECUTE from its Zod enums and platform config. Clean replacement is simpler than mapping EXECUTE -> PLAY.
evidence: Production DB: 0/852 tickets with EXECUTE mode
Server removes EXECUTE from ticket-controller Zod enum and platform-config allowedModes

answers.answer: No. MVP-1 is mode scaffolding only. The CLI just needs to accept --mode PLAY and display it in help text. Play-specific subcommands (hlx plays list/preview/run) are deferred to MVP-2+ when the server has play API endpoints.
evidence: product/product.md MVP-1: 'CLI accepts hlx tickets create --mode PLAY'
No play CRUD or execution API endpoints exist at MVP-1

answers.answer: Server must deploy first. The CLI sends mode in the POST body to /api/tickets. The server validates against platformConfig.allowedModes. If PLAY is sent before the server recognizes it, the server returns 400.
evidence: create.ts line 147: mode sent in POST body
ticket-controller.ts line 152: server validates mode against platformConfig.allowedModes

statement: CLI needs a 3-file change: replace EXECUTE with PLAY in VALID_MODES (create.ts), help text (create.ts, index.ts), and docs (cli-content.ts). This is the smallest change surface. Deploy server first. No play-specific subcommands at MVP-1.
